headline: Crypto Exchanges Shed $7.096 Billion As Coins Leave Venues
narrative: Crypto exchanges posted a 24-hour net outflow of $7.096 billion, equal to 2.80 percent of reserves, so coins left trading venues instead of arriving for sale. That pipe is accumulation: inventory moved off exchanges while bitcoin traded near 78k. Cumulative volume delta printed -675.22, the 4.7 percentile of the past 30 days, with sellers in control of spot flow.
author: jordan
